incident.category: Online and Social Media Related Crime
incident.modus_operandi: Harassment, stalking, or non-consensual dissemination of private media

complaint.raw_text: For the past several days, I have been receiving repeated threatening messages from an unknown social media account. The person is using different accounts after I block them and is sending screenshots of my personal information along with threatening statements. I have preserved the messages, usernames and screenshots as evidence. I am concerned about my safety and request that the authorities identify the person responsible and take appropriate action.

reassurance.title: Important Safety Advice & Emotional Reassurance
reassurance.message: Please remember: You are the victim of a calculated crime, and you are not alone. Extortionists rely on panic, shame, and isolation to force quick payments. Paying will NOT stop them; it only invites further extortion demands.
immediate_steps: **DO NOT transfer any money or succumb to extortion demands.**
Take screenshots of all chats, numbers, profile links, and payment handles for evidence.
Block the fraudster on all platforms once evidence is saved.
Report the profile directly to the social platform (Instagram/WhatsApp/Snapchat) to trigger account takedown.
